question: Which categories pay for the discounting?
text: Read Smart Home on its own: 50.14% margin and 2,819,862.68 of profit, with 518,339.04 given away in discounts. Its own Q4 still costs it - 46.52% in Q4 2025 against 51.36% in Q3 - but Laptops, at 12.62% over the eight quarters and 6.6% in Q4 2025, is where the discounting is paid for.

question: And what did last Q4 cost?
text: Narrow the period to Q4 2025: margin 29.03% against 32.91% over the eight quarters, 2,348,311.88 of profit, and 1,364,669.72 of discounts - 14.4% of the list price against about 6% in the three quarters around it.
